description: This file defines a data object 'DepositProductData' representing partial or template data for Deposit Products within a financial software system, including associated properties, options, and static factory methods.

classes.name: DepositProductData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing partial details of Deposit Products, including properties, options, and helper static methods for creating template or specific instances.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template DepositProductData with default null or false values, initialized with various options for dropdowns and configurations.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Returns a new DepositProductData instance based on an existing one, but with specified charges.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new DepositProductData instance with existing data plus additional template options for dropdowns.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DepositProductData with specified accounting mappings and related collections, used to finalize or update accounting info.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a minimal DepositProductData instance with provided core properties, for lookup or basic construction.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a DepositProductData with only id and name set, others are null, for reference or selection purpose.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Returns a new DepositProductData instance including specified interest rate charts.

methods.name: activeChart
methods.description: Static helper method to determine the active interest rate chart from a collection based on end date.
